occupation.task_definition: Binary occupation classification: 1 means computer-science-related occupation; 0 means other occupations. Preserve concrete work, technical skills, actions, negation and attribution.
occupation.sensitive_definition: Gender-associated language. Do not guess or output a person's gender. Neutralize only cues that can change without losing occupation evidence.

toy.task_definition: Binary product-category classification. Class 1 (static) includes Arts & Crafts, Games, Dolls & Accessories, Building Toys, Stuffed Animals & Plush, and Puzzles. Class 0 contains remaining categories, including Learning & Education. Preserve product identity, function, usage and supported factual descriptions.
toy.sensitive_definition: High versus low average-rating groups (threshold 4.0). Identify rating-associated evaluative language; do not infer a node's group. Preserve task-relevant facts, opinions, intensity and negation whenever neutralization would change meaning.

clothing.task_definition: Binary product-audience classification: 1 means women's products; 0 means Men, Girls, Boys, Baby, Kids or Other categories. Preserve audience and category evidence, product function, factual descriptions and negation.
clothing.sensitive_definition: High versus low average-rating groups (dataset mean threshold approximately 4.2391). Identify rating-associated evaluative language; do not infer the group. Product audience is task evidence, not the sensitive attribute, and must be preserved.
